candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only sets the new password and updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. Sessions on other devices therefore stay valid, and those devices can still call refreshToken (which looks up the session by id and hash) and renew their login. The update() path at around line 469 does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude when the password is changed, but the reset flow has no equivalent.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) so all of the user's sessions are revoked and every device has to sign in again.
